paragraphs.text: The Erg Mirab is a large desert in the center of South Aerona .
In the heart of the Mirab lies the Aerie , the ancestral home of the Haari Clan . At the top of the Aerie is the High Ledge . The Mirab mountains host Indorin's Tomb , a monument to a fallen knight.

The Haari are a tribe of warrior thieves who can fly like hawks using a ritual called the Form. They also refer to themselves as the Pack or bloodkin. The Aerie is a cliff dwelling where Haari youth watch over the elder Masters, the tribe's leaders. Members of the clan who have completed the Hunt range the countryside searching for provisions and loot.

It is said that the Haari descend from great prehistoric raptors. Legend claims that long ago, beings called the Old Ones or the Great Ones granted the Haari the Task. These beings may be the Thran , who were referred to by the same name by the Fallaji . As a coming-of-age ritual, they undertake the Hunt, in which they perform a Lone Flight and steal an item, called the Gift, for the tribe. Before they undertake the Hunt, they are known as a fledge. When a fledge attempts the Hunt, they are known as an initiate and paint a scarlet lightning bolt on their face. Those who complete the Hunt are known as hunters and receive a seat at High Council. Though all members are taught to fly, the Masters frown upon the uninitiated attempting it except as a last resort. The Form costs a bloodprice, namely forcing the hunter to cut off their feet, severing their tie to the land before taking flight.
